lantern_16_060.text: The second session's changed ordinary task made Yue realize how often she used a hand movement to signal speech before her release had finished. The order mattered more than the elegance of her explanation afterward. At home she told Tian the practical result and then asked about the son's new shelf. Their conversation moved on naturally. A useful physical action could belong to one day without occupying every room in the person's life.

lantern_16_061.speaker: narrator
lantern_16_061.text: Tian had decided the shelf should carry only the child's own books and chosen toys, leaving adult work papers on a separate higher shelf. Yue agreed to keep her clinical and course papers there under the household's actual arrangement. The child could ask to see a public picture and be refused private pages without being told he was untrustworthy as a person. The difference concerned the papers' purpose and owners. He chose the cold paper tower for the lower shelf. Its leaning wall had been repaired again with fresh cardboard, a small owned object that would actually move with them.

lantern_16_062.speaker: narrator
lantern_16_062.text: At the final workshop lunch, Pu brought a single bun with too much pepper and blamed Zheng's taste before remembering the man could no longer answer him. Bao, who had been invited as the clamps' household seller and an ordinary friend, said her uncle would have blamed the baker. The table laughed softly. The missing reply remained missing. Yue ate the received lunch, checked her final payment, and left the safety page where Fen could use it. Ordinary paid work, friendship, and grief had shared the term without making any of them a device that restored the others' losses.

lantern_16_063.speaker: narrator
lantern_16_063.text: Pu received the final eleven calendar days that afternoon and paid the remaining forty-four copper. Yue's completed twenty-two-day term totaled eighty-eight actually received. She returned the shop's admitted stock papers, left the received public safety sheet for its actual users, and kept her own contract and independently authored notes. Pu wanted to hire her again if a later documentation order existed. He did not reserve an indefinite place merely because they liked working together. Yue went home with a paid finite job ended, a normal following check received, and institutions still deciding which regional service they could actually fund next.

lantern_16_064.speaker: narrator
lantern_16_064.text: On Day 1650 Yue reconciled her actual private purse. The cooperative's completed proof order had paid two hundred fifty-eight copper, separately from institutional allocations. Her smaller personal purchases, private dispatches, deposits, and incidental charges totaled at most eight through Day 1410, another five through Day 1445, another five through Day 1491, and another eight thereafter: twenty-six copper altogether. Room and food followed booked nights and actual stated meal prices; course and clinic receipts remained separate. She could identify each personal charge without publishing other people's papers. Later examination and travel needed actually received personal money.
